title: Coast Guard rescues 4 fishermen 60 miles off Maine coast
description: Video of Air Station Cape Cod MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew rescuing four fishermen 60 miles off the coast of Maine, Wednesday, Nov. 14, 2018. The fishermen abandoned ship after the boat started taking on water. (U.S. Coast Guard video)
